target.body:
Bumps the android-deps group with 2 updates in the /apps/android directory: [io.kotest:kotest-assertions-core-jvm](https://github.com/kotest/kotest) and [io.kotest:kotest-runner-junit5-jvm](https://github.com/kotest/kotest). Updates `io.kotest:kotest-assertions-core-jvm` from 6.2.1 to 6.2.2
Release notes

Sourced from io.kotest:kotest-assertions-core-jvm's releases.

v6.2.2

What's Changed

  • Document instant-based ZonedDateTime plusOrMinus comparison by @​AlexCue987 with @​Copilot in kotest/kotest#6159
  • Add documentation for OffsetDateTime tolerance matcher by @​AlexCue987 in kotest/kotest#6161
  • Fix typo in proptest config docs by @​axiom in kotest/kotest#6155
  • disable return-value-checker for releases by @​alfonsoristorato in kotest/kotest#6165
  • fix(kotest-framework-engine): Use display-name rendering for ignored tests in TeamCity listener by @​sksamuel in kotest/kotest#6119
  • fix(kotest-assertions-core): Handle null map values in shouldBeEqualUsingFields by @​sksamuel in kotest/kotest#6112
  • Update dependency io.mockk:mockk to v1.14.11 by @​renovate[bot] in kotest/kotest#6163
  • fix: attach Fail fast scope tracker for each root test case in instance per spec mode by @​ashdawngary in kotest/kotest#6160
  • Update dependency io.projectreactor.tools:blockhound to v1.0.17.RELEASE by @​renovate[bot] in kotest/kotest#6164

New Contributors

  • @​AlexCue987 with @​Copilot made their first contribution in kotest/kotest#6159
